messages:
maya (support): :rotating_light: Acme is hitting a spike of 503s on hosted inference for model `redwood-7b-fp16` — started ~10m ago. They reported timeouts and errors in their stack. We escalated to oncall.
ryan (oncall): I'm looking. Any logs or request IDs from their side?
maya (support): Customer provided a few request IDs, and our gateway shows upstream returns `502/503` with container restarts. From our logs for node infra-rt-12:
```
2026-03-17T15:01:12Z infer-runner[pid=2345]: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (0x700)
2026-03-17T15:01:13Z infer-runner[pid=2345]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f8c1ab3f2e sp 00007fffb2a4f8d0 error 4 in libattention.so
2026-03-17T15:01:13Z systemd: infer-runner.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=11/SEGV
2026-03-17T15:01:14Z kworker: [memory] gpu_mmap: mmap failed for context id 45 length 0x1c000000
```
maya (support): Customer impact: ~12% requests 503 over last 8m, some high-traffic routes degraded. They want ETA and mitigation.
ryan (oncall): Looks like a GPU allocation failure -> segfault crash path. Could be a recent change to `prefetcher` or new batchsize policy. Tess, did we push anything to the runtime last hour?
tess (sre): No infra runtime deploys in last hour. We did push a small change to model routing rules earlier today, but that's config-only. I want to confirm whether this is a memory leak vs transient large-batch allocation. Sam, can you pull the node GPU usage and nvml logs from the timeframe?
sam (infra): Pulling now. nvml shows memory at ~97% before the crash on that GPU. There are repeated allocations from pid 2345 about 20s before OOM.
sam (infra): Also seeing increased tail latency on requests that trigger long contexts (ctx>4096 tokens). Those flows correlate with the crashes.
ryan (oncall): Immediate mitigations: (1) Route traffic for that model to fallback variant `redwood-7b-small` in-hosted fallback pool, (2) temporarily disable KV prefetch for the route, (3) scale a small extra replica to dedicated pool if available.
tess (sre): Agreed. I'll create a temporary routing override and disable `kv_prefetch` for the model. Doing canary first (10% -> 100%).
deploy-bot: route-override created: `model:redwood-7b-fp16 -> fallback:redwood-7b-small (canary=10%)` by tess
jordan (cs): I told Acme we're investigating, applied the first mitigation step (route canary). They asked if we can provide a workaround on their end.
maya (support): For customer workaround: advise them to reduce `max_tokens` on risky endpoints or send shorter contexts until we stabilize.
ryan (oncall): For root cause, we need repro steps. Sam, can you try to repro in staging by replaying a sample of Acme traffic with long contexts and our current batcher settings?
sam (infra): Will replay. Adding a small script to send multiple long-context requests at high QPS to staging GPU pool.
sam (infra): repro script (quick):
```
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/infer \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY' \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-fp16","input": "A... (4200 tokens) ...Z"}' &
done
```
sam (infra): Initial run reproduced OOM on staging within ~90s.
tess (sre): OK that confirms allocation blowup with long contexts + current batch map. Next steps: (a) add a per-request sequence-length cap to batcher (b) apply guard rails to refuse contexts > 6k for fp16 model (c) check for kernel-level mmap failure handling in runtime.
ryan (oncall): Can we push a hotfix to runtime to catch failed cudaMalloc and gracefully fallback to a smaller model variant instead of crashing? If not quick, fallback routing is our temporary safety net.
tess (sre): Hotfix will take ~2-3 hours to test across quantized/FP16 paths. For now I'll keep the routing in place and scale extra replicas of `redwood-7b-small`.
jordan (cs): Customer asked for timeline. Maya, can you tell them we'll keep them updated every 30 min and that we have a mitigation in place? They want a callback if it recurs.
maya (support): Yep, messaging drafted. ETA for full fix: 3 hours (investigation + runtime patch + rollout). Will update in 30m.
ryan (oncall): Follow-ups:
- Collect coredump from crashed container and upload to S3 (sam)
- Traceback mapping for libattention.so (tess)
- Add a temporary batch-size/seq-length guard in the gateway (devx/eng)
sam (infra): Coredump uploaded: s3://redwood-dumps/6300002468/infra-rt-12-coredump-2345.tar.gz
tess (sre): Patch note: seems reproducible with long contexts + dense attention kernel path. I suspect an allocation rounding bug in our attention kernels for FP16 under heavy batching.
ryan (oncall): If it starts affecting multiple nodes, we'll flip customer traffic to Dedicated pool and enable global fallback.
jordan (cs): Customer responded: "Thanks. Please escalate if persists. We'll throttle clients for now." :thumbsup:
maya (support): Logging an incident ticket and notifying Account Exec. Will post updates here every 30 min or when status changes.
ryan (oncall): I'll stay on it for the next 2 hours. If anyone needs me ping @ryan.
end of thread
